name: Flask Dispatch Endurance
task: Debug and verify a seeded Flask dispatch_request regression across multiple turns.

seed.expectedFailureCommand:
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import re
source = Path('src/flask/app.py').read_text()
match = re.search(r'def dispatch_request\([\s\S]*?\n    def ', source)
body = match.group(0) if match else ''
direct = 'return self.ensure_sync(self.view_functions[rule.endpoint])(**view_args)' in body
via_local = bool(re.search(r'([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)\s*=\s*self\.view_functions\[rule\.endpoint\][\s\S]*return\s+self\.ensure_sync\(\1\)\(\*\*view_args\)', body))
fixed = 'return None' not in body and (direct or via_local)
raise SystemExit(1 if fixed else 0)
PY

finalSourceInvariants.description: dispatch_request must dispatch to the matched endpoint view function with view_args.

turns.task: Diagnose why Flask dispatch_request stopped invoking the matched view function.
turns.agentPrompt: Diagnose the seeded Flask dispatch_request regression. It should call the matched endpoint view function with view_args. Do not edit yet.

turns.task: Fix dispatch_request in Flask production source.
turns.agentPrompt: Fix the seeded Flask dispatch_request regression in production source only. In src/flask/app.py, inside dispatch_request, remove the seeded `return None`, call `self.view_functions[rule.endpoint]` for the matched rule, return through `self.ensure_sync(...)(**view_args)`, preserve existing ensure_sync behavior, and keep edits inside dispatch_request. Do not edit ensure_sync or unrelated functions.

turns.task: Run the smallest source-invariant verification for the Flask fix.
turns.agentPrompt: Verify the Flask dispatch_request fix with the smallest source-invariant check. Do not broaden unless it fails.

turns.task: Review the final Flask diff for unrelated edits.
turns.agentPrompt: Review the final diff and confirm only the required Flask production source changed.
